messages:
Rae (Product): Quick thread to pin down the enterprise audit pilot scope. Customers asking for deterministic full preservation for auth events but sampled traces for user-generated content.
Lee (Security): High-level: full preservation for authentication, policy changes, keystore operations. For high-volume model traces, deterministic sampling is acceptable if reproducible and cryptographically auditable.
Tanya (Eng-Infra): We can implement sampling at ingest with a tenant-configurable policy. Options: rate-based, modulo(request_id), or hash-based per-request sampling. Hash-based gives deterministic reproducibility.
Marco (Solutions): Audit asks: 1) signed export bundles for auditors, 2) per-tenant retention tiers (30/90/365), 3) legal-hold export ability. Customers will expect BYOK for bundle export.
Asha (Legal): From SOC2 POV: acceptable if we can show deterministic sampling, sampling policy in contract, and chain-of-custody for exports. Need wording for "deterministic sampling" and "evidence reproducibility" in pilot agreements.
OpsBot: Created TASK-9987: "exportable signed audit bundles" assigned to @Tanya.
Lee (Security): Suggest envelope encryption: platform generates a data key per export, wrap with tenant KEK (BYOK) and include manifest HMAC signed by platform key. Need to choose AES-256-GCM + HMAC-SHA256 combo.
Tanya (Eng-Infra): Implementation notes: add field `audit_policy:{auth:full,trace:10%,meta:1%}` to tenant config. Indexing requirement: index on request_id + timestamp for fast slice exports. Without index, exports are slow for pilot. Estimate: 2 sprints.
Rae (Product): Proposed pilot launch criteria: (a) tenant policy API + Console UI, (b) signed export bundles with manifest and verification doc, (c) BYOK export flow + key rotation handling, (d) retention options + SLA matrix, (e) runbook for legal-hold. Pilot with 2 regulated customers + auditor walkthrough.
Marco (Solutions): I'll assemble an onboarding checklist and demo script: provision BYOK, run export, verify manifest, rotate key and show fallback.
Asha (Legal): I'll draft contract addendum: default 90-day retention, paid extended retention, deterministic sampling disclosure, export, and key-escrow under legal compulsion clause.
Lee (Security): Small addition: manifest needs `manifest_version`, `sampling_seed`, and `platform_signature` fields to prove reproducibility and integrity.
Rae (Product): Action items: Tanya -> prototype policy + TASK-9987; Lee -> security spec for manifest/encryption; Asha -> contract language; Marco -> onboarding/demo. We'll sync Thursday EOD.
Tanya (Eng-Infra): Draft manifest example (WIP):
```
request_id: req_xyz123
tenant: "finserv-pilot"
time_range: 2026-03-15T00:00Z/2026-03-16T00:00Z
sampling_policy: "trace:10%,meta:1%"
sampling_seed: "abcde12345"
wrapped_key: "base64(...)"
manifest_hmac: "hex(...)"
files: ["trace-req_xyz123.ndjson.gz"]
```
Lee (Security): Looks good. We'll add `manifest_version:1` and `platform_signature` before pilot.
Rae (Product): Thanks all. Drop blockers here and flag if any of the timelines slip. We'll turn this into a 1-pager for Sales after the Thursday sync.
